clue.text: Just a little uppish-it's the gin!

indicators.note: in a down clue, uppish says the word is written going upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: a little of something is a part of it

explanation.surface: Someone is a bit tipsy and blames the gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uppish' turns PART upwards in this down entry. A gin is a snare for catching animals, not the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin, short for engine, is a snare for animals, a device for catching game.

clue.text: Galatea's beloved is after a can-opener

parts.note: the opener of the word can is its first letter

explanation.surface: Galatea's lover is reduced to wanting a tin opener.
explanation.walkthrough: IS comes after A and C. In Greek myth Acis was the shepherd loved by the sea nymph Galatea.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend the shepherd Acis was loved by the nymph Galatea and killed by the jealous Cyclops Polyphemus.

clue.text: In some nursery-schools there's food available

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Some nursery schools provide meals for the children.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of 'some' and the start of 'nursery'.
explanation.definitionFit: A menu is the list of dishes a restaurant offers, the food on offer.

clue.text: Robbers given tips are confused

indicators.note: confused says the letters of the words before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: Thieves are puzzled when they receive tips.
explanation.definitionFit: Pirates are robbers at sea, plundering ships.

clue.text: The good sense shown by many over technique

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
on means over, as in on top of
science can mean skill or technique, as in the science of boxing

explanation.surface: Most people show common sense when it comes to method.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscience is the moral sense of right and wrong, the inner guide to good conduct.

clue.text: On-going course of action

definitions.meaning: a procedure, a legal action or measure taken

explanation.surface: A description of an ongoing plan of action.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the participle of going forward and a noun for a step or measure taken, as in legal proceedings.

clue.text: Fame estranges converts

indicators.note: converts is a verb here: it changes the word before it into another arrangement

explanation.surface: Celebrity drives people apart and changes them.
explanation.definitionFit: Greatness is eminence or renown, which is what fame brings.

clue.text: The stupid guy should be left in bed

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: An idiot should be left lying in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Clot is British slang for a foolish or dim person.

clue.text: She finds a low score quite OK

definitions.text: She finds a low score quite OK

parts.words: She finds a low score quite OK
parts.note: read as a singer, she is comfortable with a musical score pitched in the lowest female range

explanation.surface: A woman is happy with a poor result in a test.
explanation.walkthrough: 'score' looks like a mark in a test, but it is written music; the woman is a singer with a low voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A contralto is the lowest female singing voice, so music written low suits her.

clue.text: Sugar and peat may be mixed into cattle-feed

indicators.note: may be mixed says the letters of the two words are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: A farmer blends sugar and peat to make animal fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasturage is grazing land or the grass on it, food for grazing animals.

clue.text: Bond's way of getting even

definitions.meaning: a link or fastening that joins things

explanation.surface: How James Bond settles a score with a villain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' with its capital suggests the spy; it is a plain link.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a connecting link and a level score in a match.

clue.text: Home from one's travels

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone returns home from their journeys.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of 'one's' and the start of 'travels'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nest is a bird's home, and by extension any snug dwelling.

clue.text: Meet for a work-out

parts.note: PT is physical training, a session of exercise

explanation.surface: Arranging to meet up for an exercise session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Meet' is the old adjective meaning fitting, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Meet in its old sense means suitable or proper, as in 'it is meet and right'.

clue.text: Tense, being poor

definitions.meaning: a grammatical tense, one for unfinished past action
faulty, flawed, not up to standard

explanation.surface: Someone is anxious because they are short of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tense' looks like anxious, but it is the grammar term.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a past tense of continuing action and also means flawed or defective.

clue.text: Tentative rule Tories have broken

indicators.note: have broken says the letters of the two words are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: The Conservatives have hesitantly breached a regulation.
explanation.definitionFit: Irresolute means hesitant or undecided, uncertain like a tentative step.

clue.text: Long drink incorporating very soft fruit

parts.note: to pine is to long or yearn

indicators.note: incorporating says one piece takes another inside it

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer
PP is pianissimo, the musical mark for very soft

explanation.surface: A tall drink with some squashy fruit in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long drink' looks like a single phrase but splits: 'Long' is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The pineapple is a tropical fruit with a spiky skin.

clue.text: Check the power increase

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain, as with a horse
force means power or strength

explanation.surface: Inspect the electricity supply and boost it.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinforce is to strengthen or add to, making something greater.

clue.text: Drops in after a service

indicators.note: after says the word in follows the other piece

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, a branch of the armed services

explanation.surface: Someone pops in after church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' suggests church, but it is an armed service, the Royal Artillery.
explanation.definitionFit: Rain falls as water droplets.

clue.text: Foreign money is the making of him

parts.note: the franc is a foreign currency, once of France

explanation.surface: Money from abroad makes this man's fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'him' is the definition: the answer is a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Francis is a boy's given name, so it can stand for a man.

clue.text: Refuse to weaken

explanation.surface: Turning down the chance to grow feebler.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to turn down an offer and to fall away in strength or quality.

clue.text: Battle for some sausages?

definitions.meaning: a sea fight of 480 BC between Greeks and Persians
spicy cured sausages, plural, the question mark flagging the punning plural

explanation.surface: A fight over a plate of sausages.
explanation.definitionFit: Salamis was a famous Greek naval victory, and the same letters make the plural of a cured Italian sausage.

clue.text: Pole shown in excellent article to be continent

indicators.note: shown in says one piece is placed inside another

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI in letters
S is south, one of the poles
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A Pole proves to be an excellent sort with self-restraint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'continent' looks like the adjective meaning restrained, but it is a landmass.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia is the largest of the world's landmasses.

clue.text: A slab of standard weight

parts.note: a standard is a flag or banner
a stone is a British unit of weight, fourteen pounds

explanation.surface: A heavy slab of regular weight.
explanation.definitionFit: A flagstone is a flat paving slab.

clue.text: The heartless note or letter

indicators.note: heartless says the middle letter of the word is removed

parts.note: E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A cruel note or letter received.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the spelt-out name of the twentieth letter of the alphabet.

clue.text: Supporting party leader-or turning the other way

indicators.note: a leader is the first letter of the word party
turning the other way says the little word or is read backwards

explanation.surface: Backing a party leader or switching sides.
explanation.definitionFit: Pro means in favour of, backing a cause.

clue.text: Cuff cut short

explanation.surface: A shirt cuff that has been trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a smack round the head and to trim.

clue.text: Gather some fruit is brought on again

parts.note: to reap is to gather in a crop
pears are fruit, plural

explanation.surface: Harvested fruit is served up once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that reappears comes back on stage or into view a second time.

clue.text: Discharged coppers in need of assistance

parts.note: P is penny or pence, copper coins
aid is help or assistance

explanation.surface: Policemen dismissed and in need of help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police, but means copper coins, pennies.
explanation.definitionFit: A debt that has been discharged has been settled with money.

clue.text: A wise union will be totally detached

parts.note: wise is an old word for manner or way, as in 'in no wise'

explanation.surface: A sensible marriage will end in complete separation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' says the two pieces are joined. 'wise' is the old noun for manner, not the adjective clever.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone far off in thought is absent-minded, wholly removed from what is around them.

clue.text: The on-looker

parts.note: read as one who looks on ahead, into the future, rather than a bystander

explanation.surface: A bystander watching events.
explanation.definitionFit: A seer is a prophet who sees what lies ahead.

clue.text: This may well cause the viewer much irritation

definitions.text: This may well cause the viewer much irritation

parts.words: This may well cause the viewer much irritation
parts.note: the viewer is the eye, and the clue describes a sore swelling on an eyelid

explanation.surface: Something that annoys a television audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'viewer' suggests a TV watcher; read it as the eye itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the edge of the eyelid.

clue.text: Removed and replaced lead in time

indicators.note: replaced says the letters are put back in a different order

explanation.surface: The front-runner was taken out and substituted in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Eliminated means got rid of or taken away.
